name: Eurocodes with the Singapore National Annexes (SS EN)
edition: SS EN 1990-1997 with the Singapore National Annexes
description: The Eurocodes with the Singapore National Annexes (alpha 9 track C15, group 1 of C23): vb,0 = 20 m/s (SS EN 1991-1-4 NA), the least horizontal load of 1.5 % of the characteristic dead weight, αcc 0.85 / 1.0 (SS EN 1992-1-1 NA), γM2 1.10 (SS EN 1993-1-1 NA) and no seismic design; everything else from the base pack Eurocodes. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md for checking against the printed annexes.
